name: promptception
description: Turns a messy, spoken-style brain-dump into a clear, complete prompt, then runs it. Talk or dictate what you want (half-sentences fine) and Promptception builds the prompt you would have written if you were a prompt expert, shows it to you, asks only the questions that close real gaps, and executes on your go. Beginner-first: it teaches prompting by showing, not lecturing, and offers to build a full plan when the ask is bigger than one prompt. One command: /promptception.
